caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with tender noodles, topped with a pink naruto fish cake and chopped green onions. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
The ceramic bowl has a white base, blue and green swirling pattern, and a slightly textured, glossy rim.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl center, white outer layer, scalloped edge, smooth surface with subtle texture.
